card.name: Verbs of use right before "with"
card.fires_on: Verbs like used, administered, use, eaten or go that sit just before "with" or "together with". Seen where one drug, device or item is paired with another.

modes.label: Used with a drug or device
modes.description: Form of "use" right before "with" naming a product or medical device.
modes.example: CYTALUX is to be<< used>> with an NIR imaging system cleared by the

modes.label: Given in combination
modes.description: "Administered" or "used" before "in combination with" or "concomitantly with" another drug.
modes.example: pertuzumab<< administered>> in combination with IBRANCE.

modes.label: Go along with
modes.description: General-text verb that leads into "along with" or "together with".
modes.example: “commercials” to<< go>> along with their inventions.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with "with", "together" or "alongside".
card.plain: It fires on a verb like "used" when the next word is likely "with", as in a drug used with another product.
